content.text:
The `testBinaryDir` writes a shell script and then `New()` immediately execs it. On busy CI machines, the kernel can return ETXTBSY if the write fd hasn't fully released. This is a known issue — Go's own test infrastructure retries on ETXTBSY.

The fix: add a retry helper for `New()` in tests.

git add cmd/entire/cli/agent/external/external_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: Retry on ETXTBSY in external agent tests

On heavily loaded CI machines, the kernel can briefly report "text file
busy" when executing a shell script immediately after writing it. Add a
newExternalAgent test helper that retries New() up to 3 times on ETXTBSY,
matching the approach Go's own test infrastructure uses.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
